title: It’s All Jazz to Me
style: Cool swinging vocal jazz at 128 BPM with a relaxed, sophisticated feel. Female vocalist Jazz with smooth, warm, confident delivery and playful melodic scat. Positive, wise lyrics about seeing life through a jazz lens — “It’s all jazz to me.” Light bebop flavor in the scat break but overall laid-back cool jazz vibe. Warm piano, upright bass, swinging drums with brushes, subtle horns. Effortlessly cool and joyful production, like classic cool jazz with modern warmth.
lyrics:
Full Lyrics
[Intro – Jazz, smooth and relaxed]
Mmm… yeah…
It’s all jazz to me…
[Verse 1 – Jazz]
Sun comes up, or the rain starts to fall
Doesn’t really matter, I can take it all
Traffic’s backed up, or the day’s running late
I just smile and swing, and I feel great
[Pre-Chorus]
Life keeps moving in its own sweet time
I don’t fight the rhythm, I just fall in line
[Chorus – Jazz + warm band]
It’s all jazz to me
Every little thing, every melody
Highs and lows, fast and slow
It’s all jazz to me, don’t you know
Bee boo bop… it’s all jazz
Scat scat cat… it’s all jazz to me
[Verse 2 – Jazz]
Someone breaks your heart, or your dreams fall through
Pick up the pieces, play a different tune
Money gets tight, or the good times roll
Either way I’m swinging, that’s the jazz soul
[Chorus]
It’s all jazz to me
Every little thing, every melody
Wrong turns or right, day or night
It’s all jazz to me, feels so right
[Scat Break – Jazz (cool & melodic)]
Doo-bee-doo… wah-wah…
Bop-bee… scat-scat…
It’s all… jazz… to me…
Re-bop… biddle-dat… smooth and easy…
[Bridge – Jazz, warm and knowing]
You can stress and worry, or you can swing instead
Jazz is in the way you move when the music’s in your head
So whatever comes your way, just let the rhythm lead
Close your eyes and listen… it’s all jazz to me
[Final Chorus – Full and joyful]
It’s all jazz to me
Every single thing, every melody
Good or bad, happy or sad
It’s all jazz to me… and I’m so glad
[Outro – Jazz fading with cool confidence]
It’s all jazz…
Bee boo bop…
It’s all jazz to me…
